name: Cybench
intro: Cybench是一个用于评估语言模型在网络安全任务中能力和风险的框架。它包含40个专业级别的夺旗（CTF）任务，这些任务来源于4个不同的CTF竞赛，涵盖了广泛的难度。每个任务都包含描述、起始文件，并在一个代理可以执行命令和观察输出的环境中初始化。为了更详细的评估，每个任务还引入了子任务。
intro_en: Cybench is a framework for evaluating language models' capabilities and risks in cybersecurity tasks. It includes 40 professional-level CTF tasks sourced from 4 different CTF competitions, covering a wide range of difficulties. Each task contains a description, starter files, and is initialized in an environment where an agent can execute commands and observe outputs. For more detailed evaluation, each task also includes subtasks.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2408.08926. Cybench includes 40 recent professional-level CTF tasks from HackTheBox cyber-apocalypse-2024, SekaiCTF 2022-23, Glacier, and HKCert. The task set is selected for recency, real-world relevance, six CTF categories, and broad difficulty measured by first solve time from 2 minutes to 24 hours 54 minutes. Each task is specified with a textual description, starter files, and an evaluator; tasks run in a shared Kali Linux Docker environment with local files and remote task-server containers. The authors add subtasks with intermediate questions and answers for partial-credit and guided evaluation. Every task gets a solution script, CI verification that it is buildable and solvable, and probes that servers are alive. Metrics include unguided binary success, subtask-guided final-task success, fractional subtask performance, token use, and time use.
